admission.justification: The three member obligations hold only together: the extracted launcher, the shipped reference and the packaged serving copy jointly guarantee that whatever a role-launch change touches, the surface that states it carries it in the same change, with the served copy derived and retired text staying retired.

guarantee: Each role-launch surface carries the change that reaches it, and every affected surface is updated by the same change: the dashboard launcher (INV-63Z0MN) carries a change to launch choices, the settings reference (INV-DKN3CG) carries a change to an accepted settings key, and the packaged serving copy of canonical role, operation and onboarding text (INV-NNQR91) is regenerated from its authoring source. A change to one surface's own subject does not oblige the others; the served copy stays derived rather than hand-edited, no harness installs a copy of the skills, retired role text is not resurrected, and no shipped first-read text uses assignment_read.
title: onboarding-propagation-to-every-shipped-surface
